ncdd174c4d4.headline: Ukraine War, Day 1,475: Easing Sanctions on Russia, Trump Speaks With Putin
ncdd174c4d4.summary: The Trump administration is easing sanctions over Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, now in its fourth year. Donald Trump spoke by phone with Vladimir Putin.
ncdd174c4d4.why: Sanctions on Russia restrict its energy exports, banking and trade. Changes to them affect global energy supply and commodity flows.

n1560c3fcf6.headline: Qantas lifts international fares as war hits fuel costs
n1560c3fcf6.summary: Qantas and Air New Zealand said the Iran war has caused a sharp spike in jet fuel costs. Qantas has lifted its international fares in response.
n1560c3fcf6.why: Qantas is Australia's largest airline. Jet fuel is one of its biggest operating costs, so fuel price shifts directly affect its margins and fares.

impacts.name: Qantas
impacts.why: Higher fuel costs are pushing up fares while raising operating costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n09eec0ae00.headline: Trump predicts war will end "very soon"
n09eec0ae00.summary: US President Donald Trump said the conflict with Iran is 'almost complete' and will be over 'very soon', seeking to allay concerns about a global economic meltdown.
n09eec0ae00.why: Statements from the US president on military conflict can shift expectations for oil supply, risk appetite and global growth.
n09eec0ae00.why_moved: Trump's comments that the Iran conflict will end soon aim to reassure markets worried about a wider economic downturn and regional instability.

n09a289e49a.headline: China’s consumer inflation rises over 1 pc in Feb
n09a289e49a.summary: China's consumer price index rose 1.3% year on year in February, driven by the effects of the Spring Festival holiday, official data showed.
n09a289e49a.why: Consumer price inflation is a key gauge for China's central bank and policymakers, and it shapes expectations for interest rates and domestic demand.

nd6c3a1279e.headline: Puravankara inks JV to develop housing project in Bengaluru with Rs 1,300cr revenue potential
nd6c3a1279e.summary: Realty firm Puravankara has formed a joint venture to develop a housing project in Bengaluru with estimated revenue potential of Rs 1,300 crore.
nd6c3a1279e.why: Puravankara is an Indian real estate developer, and joint ventures are a common way to share land and development risk on housing projects.

nde603b128a.headline: India Faces Gas Supply Crunch, Here
nde603b128a.summary: Gas prices are rising in India as the Iran conflict disrupts shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. Qatari supply cuts and shipping risks have tightened LNG and LPG availability, and the government introduced emergency measures.
nde603b128a.why: India imports much of its LNG and LPG, so disruptions in Gulf shipping quickly affect domestic gas availability and prices.

n5da5297500.headline: Electricity prices make operations unprofitable, my job is to convince the Group to support and believe in Ukraine – CEO of "ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih" (P. 2)
n5da5297500.summary: The CEO of ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih said electricity prices make operations unprofitable, and that his task is to persuade the group to support the Ukrainian plant.
n5da5297500.why: ArcelorMittal is one of the world's largest steelmakers, and high energy costs are a key driver of steel plant profitability.

n422cedb282.headline: Sensex Rises 639 Points, Nifty Gains 233 To 24,261 As Iran War Concerns Ease
n422cedb282.summary: Indian equities ended higher as easing geopolitical concerns improved sentiment, with the Sensex up 639 points and the Nifty gaining 233 points. Auto stocks led gains.
n422cedb282.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's two main benchmark equity indices, tracking large listed companies. Their moves are a common gauge of domestic risk appetite.
n422cedb282.why_moved: Easing geopolitical concerns improved investor sentiment, snapping a two-day losing streak. Broader markets outperformed.

nc0dadda1d1.headline: Price cap on fuel may be considered amid oil price spike – PM
nc0dadda1d1.summary: Lithuanian Prime Minister Inga Ruginienė does not rule out a fuel price cap as energy prices have soared due to the Middle East conflict.
nc0dadda1d1.why: Price caps are government interventions that shape retail fuel prices and inflation expectations within a country.

n04066f2583.headline: Sentiment brightens as Trump hints completion of Iran excursion - Newsquawk EU Market Open
n04066f2583.summary: US trade saw a late boost to sentiment after Trump said the war could be over soon and that the US was 'very far' ahead of its initial 4-5 week estimate.
n04066f2583.why: US presidential remarks on military conflicts can quickly shift risk appetite and safe-haven demand across equity and commodity markets.
n04066f2583.why_moved: Trump's comments that the war could end soon improved risk sentiment during US trading.

na3112d836d.headline: Major new forecast tips Sydney and Melbourne house prices to fall - realestate.com.au
na3112d836d.summary: A new forecast tips Sydney and Melbourne house prices to fall, as the two biggest property markets shift from predicted growth to declines amid energy shocks and inflation fears.
na3112d836d.why: Sydney and Melbourne are Australia's largest housing markets, and house prices influence household wealth, bank lending and interest rate expectations.

n456e9e5077.headline: Record iPhone Revenue and 99% Satisfaction Still Can’t Settle the Valuation Debate
n456e9e5077.summary: Apple shares are down 6.5% over the past month, trading around $256 as of Monday, despite record iPhone revenue and high customer satisfaction.
n456e9e5077.why: Apple is one of the largest US technology companies, and its iPhone sales are a major driver of its revenue and valuation.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: The input reports shares down 6.5% over the past month, trading around $256.

n092f6fe2f1.headline: The new Audi A6L price dropped by 17,780 USD in China
n092f6fe2f1.summary: The new Audi A6L started presales in China with a price drop of 17,780 US dollars compared with the previous model. The cut is in the Chinese market.
n092f6fe2f1.why: Audi is a premium carmaker owned by Volkswagen, and Chinese price competition is central to foreign automakers' market share there.

n399117dafb.headline: VW to cut 50,000 jobs by 2030 amid Trump tariffs and falling Chinese sales
n399117dafb.summary: Volkswagen plans to cut 50,000 jobs by 2030 and reported a 54% drop in pre-tax profits amid US tariffs and falling Chinese sales. It said the Iran war could affect demand for Audi and Porsche.
n399117dafb.why: Volkswagen is one of the world's largest carmakers, owning brands including Audi, Porsche and Škoda, so its profits and restructuring signal wider pressure on the global auto sector.
n399117dafb.why_moved: The profit slump and job cuts reflect US tariff costs, falling Chinese sales and the risk of weaker demand from the Iran war.

n39f8e9dc67.headline: Bangladesh inflation touches 10-month high in Feb as food prices surge
n39f8e9dc67.summary: Bangladesh's overall inflation rose to 9.13% in February from 8.58% in January, the highest level in 10 months, as food prices surged.
n39f8e9dc67.why: Inflation data shapes central bank rate decisions and purchasing power, which matter for Bangladesh's currency, bonds and consumer-facing companies.

nd4e41202a7.headline: Middle East war enters day 12 as US, Israel unleash 'heaviest strikes' on Iran as Tehran rules out ceasefire | World News
nd4e41202a7.summary: The war between the United States, Israel and Iran entered its 12th day with no sign of easing, as American and Israeli forces carried out heavy strikes.
nd4e41202a7.why: Escalation involving Iran affects global oil supply routes and risk sentiment across energy and financial markets.
nd4e41202a7.why_moved: Continued heavy strikes with no ceasefire in sight raise supply-risk concerns for oil.

n40847c9443.headline: As Trade Growth Surged, Goldman's One-Delta Desk-Head Asks "Is China Done Exporting Deflation?"
n40847c9443.summary: Trade flow data show China is becoming less reliant on the US market, and a Goldman Sachs desk head asks whether China is still exporting deflation.
n40847c9443.why: China's export pricing shapes global goods inflation and central bank policy, so shifts in its trade mix matter for global investors.

nf422ff2be3.headline: Why ASML Investors Shouldn't Worry About Competition From China
nf422ff2be3.summary: ASML stock fell 5.5% last Friday after reports that top Chinese semiconductor executives are urging policies to develop a domestic equivalent of ASML.
nf422ff2be3.why: ASML is the sole supplier of extreme ultraviolet lithography machines needed for advanced chips, so competition threats move its shares and the chip sector.

impacts.name: ASML Holding
impacts.why: Reports of a Chinese domestic lithography push raise competitive concerns for ASML's EUV monopoly.

n8eb4fed383.headline: Days of cheap fuel numbered
n8eb4fed383.summary: Subsidised RON95 petrol at RM1.99 per litre could end if the Middle East conflict is not resolved within two months, The Star reported.
n8eb4fed383.why: Fuel subsidies in Malaysia affect government spending, inflation and consumer costs, and are sensitive to global oil prices.

n662ba44e1a.headline: Escudero backs flexible work arrangements to cushion oil price impact
n662ba44e1a.summary: Negros Occidental local governments have adopted four-day work weeks to cushion fuel price hikes, and Senator Escudero backs flexible work arrangements.
n662ba44e1a.why: Fuel prices feed into transport and power costs across the economy, so governments use labour policy to manage the impact.

nbf94924936.headline: US To Launch 'Most Intense' Military Strikes Against Iran
nbf94924936.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the day would be the most intense yet of US strikes inside Iran.
nbf94924936.why: Military escalation involving Iran affects oil supply through the Gulf and global risk sentiment.
nbf94924936.why_moved: Escalating strikes raise fears of disruption to Gulf oil shipments, which lifts crude prices and pressures risk assets.

n145916bedf.headline: US To Launch 'Most Intense' Military Strikes Against Iran
n145916bedf.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the day would be the most intense yet of strikes inside Iran. The statement signals a sharp escalation of the conflict.
n145916bedf.why: Military escalation in the Gulf region affects global oil supply routes, energy prices and risk assets.

n9cb1a930f3.headline: D-St Bulls, Rupee Regain Ground amid Global Oil Price Rollercoaster
n9cb1a930f3.summary: Indian stocks rebounded from multi-month lows, tracking gains in Asian risk assets. The rupee rose 53 paise against the US dollar after crude oil fell nearly $30 a barrel over two days.
n9cb1a930f3.why: India is a major oil importer, so falling crude prices ease its import bill and support the rupee and domestic equities.
n9cb1a930f3.why_moved: A steep fall in crude oil prices eased pressure on India's import bill and lifted risk sentiment across Asian markets.

nbbd7b45b4d.headline: ROSHIN group and Agility Logistics to develop Jeddah-based park
nbbd7b45b4d.summary: ROSHIN Group and Agility Logistics plan to develop a park based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
nbbd7b45b4d.why: Agility is a global logistics and warehousing firm, and Jeddah is a major Red Sea port city and trade gateway for Saudi Arabia.

n032757ee17.headline: FMM calls for export crisis task force amid Strait of Hormuz disruptions
n032757ee17.summary: The Federation of Malaysian Manufacturing calls for a coordinated government-industry response to the impact of the Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz disruption on manufacturing exports and maritime trade.
n032757ee17.why: Malaysia is an export-oriented manufacturing economy, so shipping disruptions in key trade routes directly affect its factories and trade flows.

n977bdfffaf.headline: US To Launch 'Most Intense' Military Strikes Against Iran
n977bdfffaf.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the day would be the most intense yet for strikes inside Iran.
n977bdfffaf.why: Escalation of military conflict in the Gulf affects oil supply risk, shipping and global risk sentiment.

n49534493e9.headline: Guv calls on fuel retailers to cooperate
n49534493e9.summary: The governor called on fuel retailers to cooperate as motorists queued to fill tanks ahead of expected fuel price increases. The increases result from the US-Israel war in Iran.
n49534493e9.why: Fuel prices feed directly into inflation and household costs in the Philippines, an oil-importing economy. Government and central bank responses influence the peso and domestic rates.

na848d19202.headline: UAE closes biggest oil refinery as Iran vows to choke off crude exports - World News
na848d19202.summary: The UAE's largest oil refinery closed on Tuesday after a drone attack. Iran vowed that no crude exports would leave the Gulf while US and Israeli bombardment continues.
na848d19202.why: Refinery outages reduce output of refined fuels, and Gulf export disruptions affect global crude and product supply.
na848d19202.why_moved: The closure of the UAE's largest refinery after a drone attack, and Iran's vow to halt Gulf crude exports, raise concerns about supply.

nd5f127bf06.headline: Ringgit rises as oil price falls after Trump signals quick end to Iran war
nd5f127bf06.summary: The Malaysian ringgit strengthened against the US dollar following a sharp drop in crude oil prices after US President Trump suggested a quick end to the Iran conflict.
nd5f127bf06.why: Currency markets react to geopolitical developments and commodity price changes, impacting trade and investment flows.
nd5f127bf06.why_moved: Trump's signal of a quick resolution to the Iran conflict eased geopolitical risk premiums, causing oil prices to fall and the ringgit to strengthen.

n05ad6ba411.headline: Silver Futures Surge ₹10,442, Prices Jump To ₹2.77 Lakh Per Kg On MCX
n05ad6ba411.summary: Silver futures on the Multi Commodity Exchange of India jumped sharply, supported by a weaker US dollar and improving global market sentiment.
n05ad6ba411.why: Precious metals like silver are sensitive to currency fluctuations and global demand; price surges affect investors and industries reliant on these commodities.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Price rise driven by weaker dollar and global demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n05ad6ba411.why_moved: Silver prices rose sharply due to a weaker US dollar boosting demand and strong global market sentiment supporting precious metals.
